units.rawText: After checking the casualty rate over and over again, Wisdom's face is filled with disbelief.
units.displayText: After checking the casualty rate over and over again, Wisdom's face is filled with disbelief.

spans.text: After checking the casualty rate over and over again, Wisdom's face is filled with disbelief.

units.rawText: ...Professor, have you ever directed Sanctifiers before?
units.displayText: ...Professor, have you ever directed Sanctifiers before?

spans.text: ...Professor, have you ever directed Sanctifiers before?

options.rawText: No, I've simply had a lot of contact with you guys.
options.displayText: No, I've simply had a lot of contact with you guys.

spans.text: No, I've simply had a lot of contact with you guys.

options.rawText: Yes, I once conquered far and wide at the head of an army of Sanctifiers.
options.displayText: Yes, I once conquered far and wide at the head of an army of Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Yes, I once conquered far and wide at the head of an army of Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: So I've got a pretty good understanding of Sanctifier combat formations and how to direct them.
units.displayText: So I've got a pretty good understanding of Sanctifier combat formations and how to direct them.

spans.text: So I've got a pretty good understanding of Sanctifier combat formations and how to direct them.

units.rawText: Well... Even if you say that, you know us far too well. Your directives are decisive and crystal clear.
units.displayText: Well... Even if you say that, you know us far too well. Your directives are decisive and crystal clear.

spans.text: Well... Even if you say that, you know us far too well. Your directives are decisive and crystal clear.

units.rawText: Sadly, that's a thing of the past now.
units.displayText: Sadly, that's a thing of the past now.

spans.text: Sadly, that's a thing of the past now.

units.rawText: ...Don't treat me like a fool.
units.displayText: ...Don't treat me like a fool.

spans.text: ...Don't treat me like a fool.

units.rawText: You're just an ordinary agent, yet you're so familiar with us... No wonder Lady Eucharist...
units.displayText: You're just an ordinary agent, yet you're so familiar with us... No wonder Lady Eucharist...

spans.text: You're just an ordinary agent, yet you're so familiar with us... No wonder Lady Eucharist...

units.rawText: ...Good thing I chose to work together with you.
units.displayText: ...Good thing I chose to work together with you.

spans.text: ...Good thing I chose to work together with you.

units.rawText: Wait! Something's wrong over at the treatment area!
units.displayText: Wait! Something's wrong over at the treatment area!

spans.text: Wait! Something's wrong over at the treatment area!

units.rawText: <size=40>RAWR!!</size>
units.displayText: RAWR!!

spans.text: RAWR!!

units.rawText: One of the Sanctifiers undergoing treatment suddenly roars loudly.
units.displayText: One of the Sanctifiers undergoing treatment suddenly roars loudly.

spans.text: One of the Sanctifiers undergoing treatment suddenly roars loudly.

units.rawText: It was originally a purely mechanical Lesser Sanctifier, but it is now covered by what appears to be an organic layer.
units.displayText: It was originally a purely mechanical Lesser Sanctifier, but it is now covered by what appears to be an organic layer.

spans.text: It was originally a purely mechanical Lesser Sanctifier, but it is now covered by what appears to be an organic layer.

units.rawText: The creepy purple veins rapidly spread all over the Sanctifier's body as though they were alive.
units.displayText: The creepy purple veins rapidly spread all over the Sanctifier's body as though they were alive.

spans.text: The creepy purple veins rapidly spread all over the Sanctifier's body as though they were alive.

units.rawText: There's no need for excessive analysis; everyone can sense the danger it emanates—
units.displayText: There's no need for excessive analysis; everyone can sense the danger it emanates—

spans.text: There's no need for excessive analysis; everyone can sense the danger it emanates—

units.rawText: So Sanctifiers can be infected too!?
units.displayText: So Sanctifiers can be infected too!?

spans.text: So Sanctifiers can be infected too!?

units.rawText: [Warning: Entropic infection of Sanctifier, Individual Serial Number 415411 "Raider", has reached the Tertiary Layer.]
units.displayText: [Warning: Entropic infection of Sanctifier, Individual Serial Number 415411 "Raider", has reached the Tertiary Layer.]

spans.text: [Warning: Entropic infection of Sanctifier, Individual Serial Number 415411 "Raider", has reached the Tertiary Layer.]

units.displayText: [Subject infection is irreversible, requesting sup—]

spans.text: [Subject infection is irreversible, requesting sup—]

units.rawText: Before the Refactor can finish its report, the infected Sanctifier is already lunging at it.
units.displayText: Before the Refactor can finish its report, the infected Sanctifier is already lunging at it.

spans.text: Before the Refactor can finish its report, the infected Sanctifier is already lunging at it.

units.rawText: Healing units, fall back! "Fortitudes", pin it down!
units.displayText: Healing units, fall back! "Fortitudes", pin it down!

units.displayText: Wisdom raises her gun and takes aim at the infected Sanctifier as she gives the order.

units.displayText: [Suppression complete.]

units.displayText: Wisdom's finger tightens on her trigger, ready to send her bullet downrange at any time—

Wait!

units.rawText: There might still be a way!
units.displayText: There might still be a way!

spans.text: There might still be a way!

units.rawText: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. It has already been completely modified into a virus.
units.displayText: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. It has already been completely modified into a virus.

spans.text: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. It has already been completely modified into a virus.

units.rawText: There is nothing we can do.
units.displayText: There is nothing we can do.

spans.text: There is nothing we can do.

units.rawText: There is no need for pity. I can tell, even without Wisdom's explanation, that there is no saving this Sanctifier.
units.displayText: There is no need for pity. I can tell, even without Wisdom's explanation, that there is no saving this Sanctifier.

spans.text: There is no need for pity. I can tell, even without Wisdom's explanation, that there is no saving this Sanctifier.

units.rawText: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. Just about all of the Sanctifier's code has been overwritten at this point.
units.displayText: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. Just about all of the Sanctifier's code has been overwritten at this point.

spans.text: The infection has reached its Tertiary Layer. Just about all of the Sanctifier's code has been overwritten at this point.

units.rawText: Wisdom has made the right call.
units.displayText: Wisdom has made the right call.

spans.text: Wisdom has made the right call.

units.rawText: Bang—!
units.displayText: Bang—!

spans.text: Bang—!

units.rawText: Wisdom's sniper round instantly pierces through the infected Sanctifier. It keels over onto its back and thrashes around a little before finally dissolving into data and vanishing.
units.displayText: Wisdom's sniper round instantly pierces through the infected Sanctifier. It keels over onto its back and thrashes around a little before finally dissolving into data and vanishing.

spans.text: Wisdom's sniper round instantly pierces through the infected Sanctifier. It keels over onto its back and thrashes around a little before finally dissolving into data and vanishing.

units.rawText: ...Dammit.
units.displayText: ...Dammit.

spans.text: ...Dammit.

units.rawText: Wisdom quickly composes herself, once again showing the discipline and qualities of a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Wisdom quickly composes herself, once again showing the discipline and qualities of a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Wisdom quickly composes herself, once again showing the discipline and qualities of a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Namely, efficiency and ruthlessness.
units.displayText: Namely, efficiency and ruthlessness.

spans.text: Namely, efficiency and ruthlessness.

units.rawText: Now then, Professor. Let us continue our negotiations before we are interrupted again.
units.displayText: Now then, Professor. Let us continue our negotiations before we are interrupted again.

spans.text: Now then, Professor. Let us continue our negotiations before we are interrupted again.
I understand the situation.
I have a condition.

units.rawText: The scope of the Entropic infection this time is far beyond your expectations. You can't handle it with your squad alone.
units.displayText: The scope of the Entropic infection this time is far beyond your expectations. You can't handle it with your squad alone.

spans.text: The scope of the Entropic infection this time is far beyond your expectations. You can't handle it with your squad alone.

units.rawText: That's why you need to gather all the fighting strength you can.
units.displayText: That's why you need to gather all the fighting strength you can.

spans.text: That's why you need to gather all the fighting strength you can.

units.rawText: That... that's not entirely true. We could withdraw now, or wait for reinforcements.
units.displayText: That... that's not entirely true. We could withdraw now, or wait for reinforcements.

spans.text: That... that's not entirely true. We could withdraw now, or wait for reinforcements.

units.rawText: We have some clues that indicate the source of the infection stems from the administrator, but my squad can't continue further into the sector.
units.displayText: We have some clues that indicate the source of the infection stems from the administrator, but my squad can't continue further into the sector.

spans.text: We have some clues that indicate the source of the infection stems from the administrator, but my squad can't continue further into the sector.

units.rawText: More importantly, I don't want to let Lord Eosphorus down.
units.displayText: More importantly, I don't want to let Lord Eosphorus down.

spans.text: More importantly, I don't want to let Lord Eosphorus down.

units.rawText: I just happened to see you back then, and I was reminded of Lady Eucharist's description of you, so I decided to try my luck.
units.displayText: I just happened to see you back then, and I was reminded of Lady Eucharist's description of you, so I decided to try my luck.

spans.text: I just happened to see you back then, and I was reminded of Lady Eucharist's description of you, so I decided to try my luck.

units.rawText: I need to awaken my friends.
units.displayText: I need to awaken my friends.

spans.text: I need to awaken my friends.

units.rawText: In truth, we were trying to cleanse you of the infection just now, but the effects were minimal.
units.displayText: In truth, we were trying to cleanse you of the infection just now, but the effects were minimal.

spans.text: In truth, we were trying to cleanse you of the infection just now, but the effects were minimal.

units.rawText: You were the only one who woke up soon after I cleansed you once. The others remained unconscious.
units.displayText: You were the only one who woke up soon after I cleansed you once. The others remained unconscious.

spans.text: You were the only one who woke up soon after I cleansed you once. The others remained unconscious.

units.rawText: Wisdom's words remind me of my experience in my Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: Wisdom's words remind me of my experience in my Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: Wisdom's words remind me of my experience in my Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.
units.displayText: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.

spans.text: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.

units.rawText: It would seem the "cleansing" that Wisdom spoke of was very likely what had allowed me to see the truth.
units.displayText: It would seem the "cleansing" that Wisdom spoke of was very likely what had allowed me to see the truth.

spans.text: It would seem the "cleansing" that Wisdom spoke of was very likely what had allowed me to see the truth.

units.rawText: In any case, just come over here.
units.displayText: In any case, just come over here.

spans.text: In any case, just come over here.

units.rawText: After cleaning up the battlefield, Wisdom and I return to Persicaria's side.
units.displayText: After cleaning up the battlefield, Wisdom and I return to Persicaria's side.

spans.text: After cleaning up the battlefield, Wisdom and I return to Persicaria's side.

units.rawText: [Performing neural cloud diagnostic...]
units.displayText: [Performing neural cloud diagnostic...]

spans.text: [Performing neural cloud diagnostic...]

units.rawText: [Subject neural cloud firewall integrity at 97%, possible deviation of 32%. Entropic infection status—moderate.]
units.displayText: [Subject neural cloud firewall integrity at 97%, possible deviation of 32%. Entropic infection status—moderate.]

spans.text: [Subject neural cloud firewall integrity at 97%, possible deviation of 32%. Entropic infection status—moderate.]

units.rawText: You said the effects of cleansing on them were minimal.
units.displayText: You said the effects of cleansing on them were minimal.

spans.text: You said the effects of cleansing on them were minimal.

units.rawText: So the girl in white that I saw in my coma—in my Tertiary Layer—wasn't you?
units.displayText: So the girl in white that I saw in my coma—in my Tertiary Layer—wasn't you?

spans.text: So the girl in white that I saw in my coma—in my Tertiary Layer—wasn't you?

units.rawText: A girl in white?
units.displayText: A girl in white?

spans.text: A girl in white?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, I don't know what you're talking about... It's true that I wear white, but we didn't have the energy to spare on diving into your base layers to awaken you.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, I don't know what you're talking about... It's true that I wear white, but we didn't have the energy to spare on diving into your base layers to awaken you.

spans.text: Unfortunately, I don't know what you're talking about... It's true that I wear white, but we didn't have the energy to spare on diving into your base layers to awaken you.

units.rawText: My team had their hands full just keeping the Entropics outside the defense line.
units.displayText: My team had their hands full just keeping the Entropics outside the defense line.

spans.text: My team had their hands full just keeping the Entropics outside the defense line.

units.rawText: Even I couldn't be entirely sure if I had the ability to retreat safely from an Entropy-infected Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: Even I couldn't be entirely sure if I had the ability to retreat safely from an Entropy-infected Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: Even I couldn't be entirely sure if I had the ability to retreat safely from an Entropy-infected Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: I'm sure you understand too, but taking the risk to enter an infected individual's Tertiary Level while surrounded by Entropics would not be wise.
units.displayText: I'm sure you understand too, but taking the risk to enter an infected individual's Tertiary Level while surrounded by Entropics would not be wise.

spans.text: I'm sure you understand too, but taking the risk to enter an infected individual's Tertiary Level while surrounded by Entropics would not be wise.

units.rawText: [Diagnostic complete. Subject neural cloud is still in a dormant state. Attempt to awaken Y/N?]
units.displayText: [Diagnostic complete. Subject neural cloud is still in a dormant state. Attempt to awaken Y/N?]

spans.text: [Diagnostic complete. Subject neural cloud is still in a dormant state. Attempt to awaken Y/N?]

units.rawText: I will lead my squad outside and ensure your safety—if you can trust me.
units.displayText: I will lead my squad outside and ensure your safety—if you can trust me.

spans.text: I will lead my squad outside and ensure your safety—if you can trust me.

units.rawText: I trust you. After all, making a move on us under these circumstances would be shooting yourself in the foot.
units.displayText: I trust you. After all, making a move on us under these circumstances would be shooting yourself in the foot.

spans.text: I trust you. After all, making a move on us under these circumstances would be shooting yourself in the foot.

units.rawText: Oh, the reason isn't as driven by selfish interests as that... Do I look like someone who doesn't keep my word?
units.displayText: Oh, the reason isn't as driven by selfish interests as that... Do I look like someone who doesn't keep my word?

spans.text: Oh, the reason isn't as driven by selfish interests as that... Do I look like someone who doesn't keep my word?

units.rawText: Alright then, I'll be counting on you.
units.displayText: Alright then, I'll be counting on you.

spans.text: Alright then, I'll be counting on you.

units.rawText: I use the method the Sanctifier gave me and prepare to enter Persicaria's neural cloud. But before I can make my move...
units.displayText: I use the method the Sanctifier gave me and prepare to enter Persicaria's neural cloud. But before I can make my move...

spans.text: I use the method the Sanctifier gave me and prepare to enter Persicaria's neural cloud. But before I can make my move...

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Persicaria suddenly awakens and stares straight ahead with fear in her eyes.
units.displayText: Persicaria suddenly awakens and stares straight ahead with fear in her eyes.

spans.text: Persicaria suddenly awakens and stares straight ahead with fear in her eyes.

units.rawText: Persicaria, it's alright!
units.displayText: Persicaria, it's alright!

spans.text: Persicaria, it's alright!

units.rawText: I pat Persicaria lightly on the back and her panic gradually subsides.
units.displayText: I pat Persicaria lightly on the back and her panic gradually subsides.

spans.text: I pat Persicaria lightly on the back and her panic gradually subsides.

units.rawText: Professor, it looks like your awakening was not an exception.
units.displayText: Professor, it looks like your awakening was not an exception.

spans.text: Professor, it looks like your awakening was not an exception.

units.rawText: A Sanctifier?! Professor, look out!
units.displayText: A Sanctifier?! Professor, look out!

spans.text: A Sanctifier?! Professor, look out!

units.rawText: Upon noticing Wisdom's presence, Persicaria pushes me behind her without any further explanation and gathers operands in her hands.
units.displayText: Upon noticing Wisdom's presence, Persicaria pushes me behind her without any further explanation and gathers operands in her hands.

spans.text: Upon noticing Wisdom's presence, Persicaria pushes me behind her without any further explanation and gathers operands in her hands.

units.rawText: Stand down, Persicaria! We're working together now.
units.displayText: Stand down, Persicaria! We're working together now.

spans.text: Stand down, Persicaria! We're working together now.

units.rawText: ...Working together? Huh? Us and the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: ...Working together? Huh? Us and the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: ...Working together? Huh? Us and the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: It's a long story, but just put your weapon away for now. I'll explain in more detail once everyone has awakened.
units.displayText: It's a long story, but just put your weapon away for now. I'll explain in more detail once everyone has awakened.

spans.text: It's a long story, but just put your weapon away for now. I'll explain in more detail once everyone has awakened.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: ...It seems the awakening went quite well.
units.displayText: ...It seems the awakening went quite well.

spans.text: ...It seems the awakening went quite well.

units.rawText: No, Persicaria woke up before I could even connect to her.
units.displayText: No, Persicaria woke up before I could even connect to her.

spans.text: No, Persicaria woke up before I could even connect to her.

units.rawText: Was that the "girl in white" at work, the one you were talking about?
units.displayText: Was that the "girl in white" at work, the one you were talking about?

spans.text: Was that the "girl in white" at work, the one you were talking about?

units.rawText: In other words, there's a third party helping us out...
units.displayText: In other words, there's a third party helping us out...

spans.text: In other words, there's a third party helping us out...

units.rawText: Um... Would you mind keeping out of sight for a bit?
units.displayText: Um... Would you mind keeping out of sight for a bit?

spans.text: Um... Would you mind keeping out of sight for a bit?

units.rawText: I'm worried you might get hurt by accident if they suddenly wake up...
units.displayText: I'm worried you might get hurt by accident if they suddenly wake up...

spans.text: I'm worried you might get hurt by accident if they suddenly wake up...

units.rawText: Ugh... Fine...
units.displayText: Ugh... Fine...

spans.text: Ugh... Fine...

units.rawText: It seems that when combat isn't involved, this Sanctifier before my eyes takes on strange qualities...
units.displayText: It seems that when combat isn't involved, this Sanctifier before my eyes takes on strange qualities...

spans.text: It seems that when combat isn't involved, this Sanctifier before my eyes takes on strange qualities...

units.rawText: Sure enough, not long after Wisdom leaves, Sol and Antonina show signs of coming to.
units.displayText: Sure enough, not long after Wisdom leaves, Sol and Antonina show signs of coming to.

spans.text: Sure enough, not long after Wisdom leaves, Sol and Antonina show signs of coming to.

units.rawText: Come on, Prof, let's fight fair and square with live weapons! Like warriors!
units.displayText: Come on, Prof, let's fight fair and square with live weapons! Like warriors!

spans.text: Come on, Prof, let's fight fair and square with live weapons! Like warriors!

units.rawText: Professor. You. Are. DEAD.
units.displayText: Professor. You. Are. DEAD.

spans.text: Professor. You. Are. DEAD.

units.rawText: Now I'm starting to wonder what they saw in their Tertiary Layers.
units.displayText: Now I'm starting to wonder what they saw in their Tertiary Layers.

spans.text: Now I'm starting to wonder what they saw in their Tertiary Layers.

units.rawText: As the Exiles slowly wake up, I explain the situation to them.
units.displayText: As the Exiles slowly wake up, I explain the situation to them.

spans.text: As the Exiles slowly wake up, I explain the situation to them.

units.rawText: Starting from after we were attacked by the virus, my encounters in my Tertiary Layer, to how the electronic virus that attacked us is known as "Entropy"...
units.displayText: Starting from after we were attacked by the virus, my encounters in my Tertiary Layer, to how the electronic virus that attacked us is known as "Entropy"...

spans.text: Starting from after we were attacked by the virus, my encounters in my Tertiary Layer, to how the electronic virus that attacked us is known as "Entropy"...

units.rawText: As well as the fact that we're working with the Sanctifiers—
units.displayText: As well as the fact that we're working with the Sanctifiers—

spans.text: As well as the fact that we're working with the Sanctifiers—

units.rawText: We're working with the Sanctifiers!?
units.displayText: We're working with the Sanctifiers!?

spans.text: We're working with the Sanctifiers!?

units.rawText: But, but, they're SANCTIFIERS!! Have you forgotten what they've done in the past?
units.displayText: But, but, they're SANCTIFIERS!! Have you forgotten what they've done in the past?

spans.text: But, but, they're SANCTIFIERS!! Have you forgotten what they've done in the past?

units.rawText: Turing and T1641...
units.displayText: Turing and T1641...

spans.text: Turing and T1641...

units.rawText: I agree with Sol. That Wisdom of which you speak is of the same rank as Faith from Rossum. They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I agree with Sol. That Wisdom of which you speak is of the same rank as Faith from Rossum. They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I agree with Sol. That Wisdom of which you speak is of the same rank as Faith from Rossum. They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Yeah, they're all a bunch of blockheaded machines, how could they help Exiles like us!
units.displayText: Yeah, they're all a bunch of blockheaded machines, how could they help Exiles like us!

spans.text: Yeah, they're all a bunch of blockheaded machines, how could they help Exiles like us!

units.rawText: I understand your concerns. I felt the same way when I first woke up.
units.displayText: I understand your concerns. I felt the same way when I first woke up.

spans.text: I understand your concerns. I felt the same way when I first woke up.

units.rawText: But I trust the Professor's judgment, and objectively speaking, the Sanctifiers DID save us...
units.displayText: But I trust the Professor's judgment, and objectively speaking, the Sanctifiers DID save us...

spans.text: But I trust the Professor's judgment, and objectively speaking, the Sanctifiers DID save us...

units.rawText: Eucharist helped me and the Professor out back in the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: Eucharist helped me and the Professor out back in the Enigma Sector.
